news.title: WMK 6 News at Eleven
lines: Good evening, Marlowe Keys. I'm Dale Vance, and this is W M K Six News at eleven. The only newscast legally allowed in this county.
Our top story. A tide warning for Tideline Beach tonight. Public Safety says stay off the sand. I say the sand was never your friend.

At Port Salt, the longshore strike enters day three. Union steward Bernie Szabo says her people want a fair wage. Calvin Ashby says her people want to be careful. Draw your own conclusions. I've drawn mine. They're in my lawyer's safe.
And in lighter news, a man on Ashby Boulevard was arrested for getting intimate with a parking meter. He told officers it was consensual. The meter has declined to comment.
Now let's go to Bunny Marsh with the weather. Bunny, tell me something good.
Thanks Dale! Nothing good! There's a big ugly storm cell sitting off the Keys like a drunk at closing time, and honey, it is not going home alone.
Tideline, expect rain. Downtown, expect rain and gunfire. Bellwether, expect rain on your nice green lawns, you smug little s----.
Bunny, this is a family broadcast.
That's fair. That's fair. We'll be right back after this word from Tide Cola. Somebody get me a g------ drink.

cola.title: Tide Cola
lines: Hey. I'm Chet Gaines. Two time Gulf Coast champion. One time acquitted.
When I need to feel alive, I reach for an ice cold Tide Cola.
Brewed with real Marlowe Keys water. Mostly the clean part.
It's got sugar. It's got caffeine. It's got a chemical the government hasn't named yet.
Tide Cola may cause jitters, rashes, regret, and in rare cases, a second set of teeth. Not for sale in three states or to anyone on parole.
Tide Cola. Taste the tide. D--- right.

spin.title: Spin City
lines: Welcome back to Spin City! The only game show where the wheel is crooked, and so is your host!
Darlene from Gannet Landing, you are one spin away from tonight's grand prize. A brand new jet ski, and a weekend at the Seagrape Motor Inn. Bed bugs sold separately.
Oh my god, Rex. I'm so nervous I think I peed a little.
That's live television, sweetheart. Now spin that b----!
Round and round she goes, and where she stops, the producers already decided!
Oh! Bust! That's a damn shame, Darlene. You go home with nothing. Just like my four ex wives.
This is rigged! You lying son of a b----! I drove two hours for this!
Security! Get her off my stage. Folks, we'll be right back. I need a drink, and possibly a lawyer.

lawyer.title: Kessler & Associates
lines: Were you hurt on the job? In a car? By a cop? By a pelican?
I'm Marty Kessler, and I sue everybody. I've sued the city. The county. The Coast Guard. My own mother. Twice.
Call one eight hundred, K E S S L E R. If you can't spell it, you've got a brain injury, and that, my friend, is a case.
Kessler and Associates. There are no associates. It's just me. Please call. My landlord is watching this.

gull.title: Captain Gull's Pier Patrol
lines: Ahoy, boys and girls! It's me, Captain Gull! Who wants to learn about the ocean?
The ocean is big, and wet, and full of garbage. Just like your daddy's bass boat.
Today's lesson is sharing. When you find a french fry on the boardwalk, you share it. With me. Or I take your f------ eyes.
Whoa, whoa. Did they bleep that? Late? Ten years on this show and now they bleep me. Thanks a lot, Gary.
Sorry, kids. Captain Gull's had a long week. My agent won't call me back, and I owe a crab named Gus eight hundred bucks.
Remember, kids. Stay in school. Stay off the pier. And never, ever trust a pelican. See you next time, you little b-------!

movie.title: The Long Tide
lines: The Keys. Ninety square miles of salt, sin, and people who should have known better. I was one of them.
You came, Jack. I didn't think you had the guts.
I've got guts, Vivian. I just keep them where you can't reach them with a knife.
The money's on the boat. Half a million dollars, and nobody ever has to know.
Somebody always knows, sweetheart. In this town, even the fish talk.
Then let them talk. Kiss me, you stupid bastard.
She tasted like cheap gin and bad decisions. I should have walked away. But nobody leaves the Keys, kid. Not even the tide.
